excerpt.zh: 在一阵灵能风暴中，[from.GetName]被替成了来源不明的[from.GetClassName]。
excerpt.en: In a flurry of psionic activity, [from.GetName] was switched with a [from.GetClassName] from parts unknown.

texts.zh: 在一阵灵能风暴中，[from.GetName]被替成了来源不明的[from.GetClassName]。
texts.en: In a flurry of psionic activity, [from.GetName] was switched with a [from.GetClassName] from parts unknown.

texts.zh: 一股灵能浪潮席卷了[from.GetName]，使其部分人口发生了违背自然法则的改变。整个群体都被重塑了，它们的形态变得奇怪而陌生，仿佛有某种我们无法理解的东西改写了他们的本质。
texts.en: A surge of psionic energy has swept through [from.GetName], leaving parts of its population altered in ways that defy natural law. Entire groups have been reshaped, their forms now alien and unfamiliar, as if something beyond our understanding has rewritten their very essence.

texts.zh: 一股灵能浪潮重塑了[from.GetName]，时期变成了一颗具有截然不同性质的新恒星。如今，一颗[from.GetClassName]正向[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系投射着它怪异的光，仿佛现实本身被扭曲了一般。
texts.en: A surge of psionic energy has remade [from.GetName], transforming it into a star of an entirely new nature. Now, a [from.GetClassName] casts its strange light upon the [from.solar_system.GetName] System, as if reality itself has been altered.

label.zh: 即使是恒星也未能幸免……
label.en: Even the stars are not immune...
